atc_bed_adapter: STOCK MDF BED riser, bed coordinates (origin = bed centre). No new holes in the bed:
clamps through the 3 right-column bed screws (x=129.5; y=-100.5/-6.75/74; Ø6.6 thru, Ø11x6.5 cbore) -> replace stock M6x23 with M6x30.
Locates on 4 mm dowel (142,-15). Magazine: M6 at (140,80) M6x16 + (140,-100) M6x20 into captive M6 nuts (10.2 AF x 8 deep from below).
Toolsetter clearance R7.2. Mill on the Carvera from 12 mm HDPE / 6061 (tapped=True), or print PETG 6 walls 50 %.
bore_test_coupons: Print FIRST in the same filament/settings as the gears. Top row: Ø13.9-14.3 (lever cylinder, BottomGear).
Bottom row: Ø7.9-8.3 + 3.2 mm key (motor shaft, TopGear). Ticks 1-5 = smallest..largest.
Pick the snug press-fit; in OrcaSlicer set Quality > 'X-Y hole compensation' = (chosen - nominal)/2. Do NOT scale the gear (teeth would change).
magazine_chip_cap: Push-in cap for the Ø11 M6 counterbores in the magazine. Print in TPU or PETG. Pull tab on top.
signal_board_box: Holds a 30x20 perfboard (PC817 or 2N2222 inverter). Cable notches both ends, zip-tie channels under base.
